blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Ilocos Norte recorded 65 new dengue cases during morbidity week 42, or from October 11 to 17. This update brings the total to 2,777 cases and four deaths from January to October 2026, according to the Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU). The latest data cover morbidity weeks 1 to 42, PESU said on Thursday, Oct. 29. Health authorities urged residents to continue observing dengue prevention measures to curb the spread of the mosquito-borne disease.
